title: Pinch Penny Loafers - Tan
description: What more is there to say about the iconic penny loafer? We've certainly made our mark over the years with our Pinch Penny Loafer, one of the five pairs of shoes that every man needs. We utilized Tan Labrador leather, a full grain cowhide that is burnished by hand here at Rancourt & Co. We left these unlined so you can still wear them without socks if you want but we added double leather soles so you don't have to worry about burning through the soles too quickly. Go ahead and wear these every day, they were made for it. This is a pair of loafers that just about does it all. Genuine handsewn moccasin construction. Made in Maine, USA. The perfect summer loafer: pair with chinos, a lightweight oxford shirt, and a panama hat and we promise you'll be the best dressed guy at the BBQ.
